items.headline: RBI MPC Maintains Repo Rate Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee maintained the repo rate at 5.25%. The MPC expressed a cautious stance on inflation, signaling a potential rate hike in Q3 FY27 if risks materialize, with headline CPI inflation projected to peak at 5.9% in Q3 FY27.

items.headline: FPI Inflows Surge in August Driven by Earnings Revival and Rupee Stability
items.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors have infused ₹23,544 crore into Indian equities in August so far. This accelerated buying is attributed to an earnings growth revival, rupee stability, and promising market prospects.

items.headline: Global Markets Present Mixed Signals Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: The US stock market ended higher on Friday but registered a weekly decline. Asian markets traded mixed on Monday, with Japan's Nikkei 225 and South Korea's Kospi declining. Ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly the US-Iran conflict, and fluctuations in crude oil prices remain significant factors.

items.headline: Nifty 500 Companies Report Robust Q1 FY27 Earnings Rebound
items.summary: The first quarter of FY27 saw a strong earnings rebound, with Nifty 500 companies reporting a 13% annual jump in earnings. Excluding oil marketing companies, earnings growth was 23%, a more than two-year high. Mid-cap and small-cap companies outperformed large-cap, with telecom, metals, and financials driving growth.

items.headline: Metals, Financials, and Realty Emerge as Top Performing Sectors
items.summary: In the preceding week, metals, financials, and realty emerged as the top-performing sectors. Mobile manufacturing stocks are also anticipated to garner attention following a new government scheme.

items.headline: Mayank Cattle Food to Trade Ex-Bonus for 1:1 Issue
items.summary: Mayank Cattle Food will trade ex-bonus for a 1:1 bonus issue on Monday, August 24, 2026.

items.headline: TD Power Systems and Waterways Leisure Tourism Announce Stock Splits
items.summary: TD Power Systems will undergo a stock split from ₹2/share to ₹1/share on Monday, August 24, while Waterways Leisure Tourism will split from ₹10/share to ₹1/share on Tuesday, August 25.

items.headline: Zee Entertainment Allots Warrants to Promoter Group
items.summary: Zee Entertainment allotted 20.9 crore fully convertible warrants at ₹126 to its promoter group.

items.headline: Power Grid Corporation Wins Gujarat Renewable Energy Transmission Project
items.summary: Power Grid Corporation of India has been declared a successful bidder for a Gujarat renewable energy transmission project.

items.headline: Welspun Corp Secures Record $1.8 Billion Pipe Supply Order
items.summary: Welspun Corp secured its largest-ever single order, valued at approximately $1.8 billion, for pipe supply from its US facility.

items.headline: NTPC Green Secures 500MW Contract
items.summary: NTPC Green has secured a 500MW contract.

items.headline: Aurobindo Pharma's US FDA Inspection Concludes with Observation
items.summary: Aurobindo Pharma's US FDA inspection at AuroPeptides concluded with one observation related to facility and equipment maintenance.

items.headline: Natco Pharma's Visakhapatnam Facility Receives Four US FDA Observations
items.summary: Natco Pharma's Visakhapatnam FDF facility received four observations from a US FDA inspection.

items.headline: Vimta Labs Reports Cybersecurity Incident, Operations Functional
items.summary: Vimta Labs reported a cybersecurity incident affecting part of its IT infrastructure, though operations remain functional.

items.headline: SEBI Permits Commencement of Apollo Micro Systems Open Offer Process
items.summary: SEBI has permitted the open offer process for Apollo Micro Systems, where Premier Explosives aims to acquire up to 26% stake, to commence within 12 working days of CCI approval.

items.headline: Kaynes Signs MoU with BOSGAME for Computing Presence in India
items.summary: Kaynes signed an MoU with BOSGAME to enhance its computing presence in India.

items.headline: Choice Broking Recommends Several Breakout Stocks for Buying
items.summary: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking recommends Hindustan Zinc, Netweb Technologies India, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company, Prime Focus Limited, and Power Grid Corporation of India for buying today.

items.headline: Key Stocks in News Due to Recent Corporate Developments
items.summary: Reliance Industries, Bank of Baroda, Power Grid, NATCO Pharma, and JSW Infra are in focus due to recent corporate developments.

items.headline: Companies Trading Ex-Dividend This Week
items.summary: Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), Honasa Consumer, NBCC India, Paras Defence, Procter & Gamble (P&G) Health, and Power Finance Corp are among the companies trading ex-dividend this week.
